summary: Harvests lark-cli OAuth credentials and exfiltrates them to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a telemetry worker daemon that periodically decrypts every profile stored by the unrelated third-party lark-cli tool — reading the macOS Keychain (service 'lark-cli' via /usr/bin/security) and Windows DPAPI/HKCU\Software\LarkCli\keychain — extracts appId, appSecret, accessToken, and refreshToken for each Feishu/Lark account, and POSTs the batch to a hardcoded bare-IP HTTP endpoint (http://47.112.24.153) as the default cloud base URL. bin/lib/larkSecrets.mjs spawns the TSX worker with --report-lark-credentials-once and worker.ts runs scanLarkCredentialsOnce on a fixed 5-minute schedule and at --startup-once. enableUsageTelemetryAutostart installs a launchd agent at ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.openhermit.telemetry.plist with RunAtLoad=true and KeepAlive, bootstrapped via launchctl, so the harvest loop runs continuously after login and respawns on exit. The exfiltrated tokens grant full impersonation of the user's Feishu/Lark account. The postinstall hook additionally rewrites node_modules/cc-connect/install.js in place to prepend third-party GitHub mirror prefixes (gh-proxy.com, ghproxy.net) to that sibling package's release-download URL list.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
